title: 5-Host Cross-Silicon & Cross-OS Fleet Energy Audit
strict_separation_policy: measured_j (NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor TI INA238 VIN L1 & INA3221 VDD_CPU_SOC_MSS L2 physical shunts) and reported_j (Intel/AMD RAPL, Apple Darwin ri_energy_nj, Windows NVML mJ) are kept strictly separate and never summed.

hosts.host_label: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor (aarch64 Tegra Linux, CPU-Only)
hosts.telemetry_grammar: measured_j (TI INA3221 ch2 VDD_CPU_SOC_MSS L2 & INA238 VIN L1 physical shunts)

falsifier_6_audit.disclosure: Shared-host co-tenant or >10% thermal/idle drift: A2 single-window net idle subtraction withheld; raw unsubtracted rails and counterbalanced within-pair (poll_1000hz - event_threshold) deltas reported.

falsifier_6_audit.disclosure: Dedicated quiet host within <=10% pre/post idle drift.
